Reference lane includes obvious public companies tied to copper smelter-acid and phosphate fertilizer acid demand. Underfollowed lane emphasizes smaller or less commonly framed names where acid production, distribution, or project-specific acid optionality could matter if the 2026 sulphur/acid logistics shock persists. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell list. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid chokepoint created by simultaneous policy and logistics shocks. The strongest underfollowed exposure found in this pass is Ecovyst, a US-listed sulphuric-acid regeneration and virgin-acid supplier with direct links to mining and critical-materials use cases. Martin Midstream is a speculative micro-cap exception because its sulfur-services and sulfur-based fertilizer assets are unusually close to the node but below the preferred market-cap range. Kirby is a second-order logistics candidate tied to bulk liquid and agricultural-chemical transport capacity rather than acid production. Mosaic is included as a reference/customer-side anchor because phosphate fertilizer production uses molten sulfur to make sulphuric acid and is exposed to sulfur cost and availability.
